race.comment: THE CRIMSON PIRATE (7) returned in good order, missing narrowly over 1400m in a good return. That's a nice platform for him to build on and things look to work out favourably for him here. Fiore reunites and with improvement in store, he can bounce back to winning ways. SUPERNATURAL (6) got a long way back last start but was good in defeat. finishing nicely out to the mile for the first time. She's likely to get back from the draw again, but she rates highly on her last start and a repeat of that effort will see her right in the finish. YES I KNOW (11) won well two back before a 0.9L defeat over 1400m at this track last time out. Out to the mile again is no issue and CJP hops back on board. Watch for him flying late. ALL GRUNT (8) can improve third-up.
